beads_commands.name: complete acceptance criteria
beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0207: Create canonical schemas and golden contract fixtures

argv: Accepted the canonical six-contract M1 wire authority and deterministic golden-fixture set with strict schemas, compatibility rules, generated manifests, round-trip coverage, and zero-drift verification.

Evidence: contract-set.json/schema pin the accepted registry, handshake, observation, recall, lifecycle, and terminal contracts, their strict schemas, documentation, checkers, tests, ordering, canonical encoding, and eight compatibility rules. golden-scenarios.json/schema define twenty-five positive and negative scenarios across fourteen required categories: success, zero results, degradation, cancellation, timeout, incompatibility, stale scope, malformed input, unknown optional round-trip, unknown required rejection, idempotent duplicate, idempotency conflict, partial effect, and unknown effect. The deterministic generator emits canonical LF-terminated JSONL plus a manifest containing source, generator, contract, schema, fixture-file, and per-line SHA-256 receipts; prepare materializes those files before checks. The repository checker verifies all source authorities, strict schemas, required fixtures/categories, canonical ordering/bytes/digests, opaque unknown-extension round trips, and zero generator drift. Mutation tests reject missing/reordered contracts, schema weakening, missing rules/fixtures/categories, unknown fields/contracts, non-finite values, missing opaque round-trip payloads, and corrupted generated fixtures/manifests.
